## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Target branch

Normal work must target `development`.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added/updated where applicable
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Lint/static checks pass
- [ ] No secrets or real target data are included

## Documentation

- [ ] Architecture docs updated if boundaries changed
- [ ] Security model updated if trust/scope behavior changed
- [ ] CLI/API/config/report docs updated if contracts changed
- [ ] ADR added/updated for a significant design decision
- [ ] PROJECT_STATUS/ROADMAP updated if milestone status changed
- [ ] No documentation changes required

## Provenance

- [ ] This change is independently implemented
- [ ] No source/prompts/tests/assets were copied from reference products
- [ ] New dependencies have known source/license
- [ ] Required third-party notices/attribution are included

## Security impact

Describe new privileges, network access, filesystem writes, sandbox changes or scope behavior. Write "None" if not applicable.
